findings.finding: The ceiling question has no explicit code name, reference or recognized construction subject. With projectCodeVersion set to the ZR bundle, routeResearchCorpora marks ZR requested via Project configured code basis. With no configured version it marks Construction requested. Recall enabled preserves Construction as recall_only, but that does not prevent the ZR requested route from activating the zoning planner/selector.

findings.limitation: Cannot assert that production used the ZR fallback without the actual routed plan or saved project.codeVersion. Accounting alone does not include those fields.

findings.finding: questionDisciplinePrefixes provides noun-based soft priors for FGC, MC, PC and AC but no BC subject prior for room/ceiling clear height. Thus the current interior-ceiling subject receives no corresponding Construction-family preference while retail/community-facility/office wording can match unrelated ZR use/bulk passages. Exact authority names are recognized, but the user should not need to name BC to obtain that preference.

findings.finding: The generic word area in retail sales area activates the area facet. An unpaid query reconstruction appends the public gross-area/supportive-housing description, existing Building Area, Tax Lot Area and FRESH Program Area to the semantic query. Those facts do not determine interior minimum ceiling clear height. Appending their original qualifications avoids false project assertions, but still moves retrieval toward ZR FAR/program topics.

findings.finding: Both verifier attempts correctly reject binding a packet-wide ceiling-height source-gap statement to ZR 35-33, a FAR provision. This is not evidence that the ceiling rule is unknowable or needs new project facts. It is a retrieval miss followed by irrelevant source binding that the bounded revision failed to remove. Disabling this verifier finding would produce a misleading citation without repairing the absent BC rule.

recommendedGeneralCorrection: Compute a shared current-question subject/measurement-object intent before reading generic project labels or choosing a fallback corpus. Ordinary interior room clearance, whole-building bulk height, component clearances and floor-area calculations are different properties even when all discuss height/area.

Use that subject for a soft family preference and compatible edition selection. A project configured codeVersion may provide the edition of an appropriate family; it must not make an unrelated code book an independently requested legal framework. Keep explicitly named mixed-authority requests, exact references, approved pinned evidence, source-only boundaries and authorized current-library recall available.

Use the same subject/property intent to filter retrieval-only project facts: retail/office use may help room-rule interpretation, while tax-lot area, unrelated FRESH status, supportive unit count and existing gross building area should not dominate an interior-clear-height query. Preserve all original facts for the writer/reviewer and their scope; this is not data deletion.
Activate zoning-specific planning/selection only for an independently requested ZR subject or explicitly pinned/authorized ZR scope; recall_only or a project metadata fallback is not sufficient.

Add offline and real website acceptance cases using unnumbered room/ceiling questions, whole-building zoning-height contrasts, mixed named requests, historic edition selections, corrections and strict selected-source boundaries. Do not add a known numeric answer or BC1208-specific output script.
